description: This file defines an interface 'ExternalOAuthAPIPlugin' that declares methods related to OAuth authentication process, including obtaining parameters, request URL, authorization URL, and access URL.

classes.name: ExternalOAuthAPIPlugin
classes.description: An interface specifying methods for OAuth operations in external API integration.

methods.name: getOauthParams
methods.description: Returns OAuth parameters needed to create an OAuth client.

methods.name: getOauthRequestURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for the OAuth request.

methods.name: getOauthAuthURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for OAuth authorization.

methods.name: getOauthAccessURL
methods.description: Returns the URL to obtain OAuth access tokens.
